name: 二枚の写真アルバム
prompt:

1. Replace the bright mint/lime outer border/tail with a very subtle thin FOREST-GREEN #1F6444 outline. Exactly this dark subdued green, no neon, no light green, no mint glow. Surface/canvas stays pure white.
2. Correct the tiny pending-status glyph beside「11:05」to match the ORIGINAL: compact rounded-SQUARE clock outline with tiny clock hands, same optical scale and slate gray as original, NOT a generic circular clock. No single/double checks, no completed state.
Keep everything else unchanged: actual apple water-droplet photograph and light-blue cup heart-latte photograph/crops/colors; one stop control at seam with filled slate square and source-like ring; exact「11:05」MeiryoRegular12/16tracking0, white footer, two-photo layout, narrow gutter, rounded corners, restrained soft shadow, full square1:1 component view. Do not modify the photos, introduce new imagery, change view/crops, duplicate controls, add other text or a phone. Photographs are fixed provided media.
reviewNotes: 修正版を目視し、明るい外周を森林緑へ、丸い時計を原画像由来の角丸四角へ修正確認。りんご/水滴と青いカップ/ハートラテの同構図2写真、単一の塗り停止四角、11:05、時計の送信中状態を保持。原画像と両切り抜きを全て閲覧・実入力。白面・緑は送信方向の細縁のみ。写真の画素同一性と厳密なクロップ等価は未確定であり、原画保護の最終受入・ネイティブ編集・実送信・所有者承認は主張しない。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
